title: UK man wins Argos laptop refund battle after court rules activating Windows 11 does not cancel rights
summary_full: A landmark court decision has established that buyers can return items purchased online within 14 days of receiving them. A University of Leicester professor successfully challenged retail titan Argos over the return of a laptop. The Court of Appeal ruled that activating pre-installed software does not forfeit the right to a refund. This ruling enhances consumer protection for electronics in the UK, prompting retailers to rethink their return policies.
